clue.text: Fabulous paradise bird held to be an irrational belief

parts.note: fabulous and super both mean excellent

indicators.note: a thing held is gripped inside something else, so the bird sits within the paradise word

parts.note: Sion (Zion) is the heavenly city, a byword for paradise
a tit is a small songbird

explanation.surface: A mythical bird from paradise is said to be a superstitious notion.
explanation.definitionFit: A superstition is a belief without rational grounds, such as fearing a black cat.

clue.text: Mysterious notice given during gaudy

indicators.note: one thing happening during another sits within its span, so the notice goes inside the gaudy word

parts.note: gaudy and showy both mean flashy
an ad (advertisement) is a notice

explanation.surface: A cryptic announcement is made in the middle of some flashy event.
explanation.definitionFit: Shadowy means obscure or mysterious, like a figure half seen in darkness.

clue.text: A sign of greens regularly in leaf

indicators.note: the regular letters are placed in the leaf word

parts.note: a leaf of a book is a page

indicators.note: taking letters at regular intervals from greens, every other one

explanation.surface: Green vegetables appearing often in a field are taken as an omen.
explanation.definitionFit: A presage is an omen or portent, a sign of what is to come.

clue.text: Spine of tent I had to fix up in part

indicators.note: the shortened pronoun and the turned peg go in the part word

parts.note: an actor's part is a role
I had contracts to I'd

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: to fix something in place is to peg it

explanation.surface: Someone describes fixing up the backbone of a tent.
explanation.definitionFit: A ridgepole is the horizontal pole along the top of a tent, its backbone.

clue.text: In principle, online resource's not hard

indicators.note: not here means the hard letter is left out of the online resource

parts.note: the Net, the internet, is the great online resource
H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils

explanation.surface: An internet site is said, in principle, to be easy going.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenet is a principle or doctrine held as true.

clue.text: Where patients are taken after operations, or just before

definitions.text: Where patients are taken after operations

explanation.surface: A hospital porter describes the route patients follow after surgery.
explanation.walkthrough: The first definition is read as TO WARDS, the destination of patients leaving theatre; the second uses towards in time, as in towards midnight.
explanation.definitionFit: Towards in time means approaching or shortly before, as in towards dawn.

clue.text: Tony bags herb box with this done up inside?

definitions.text: Tony bags herb box with this done up inside?

indicators.note: in a down clue, done up says the collected letters are read from the bottom upwards
inside takes the inner letters of each word, dropping its first and last

explanation.surface: A man named Tony stuffs a herb box, with the very herb tucked inside.
explanation.walkthrough: Strip each of Tony, bags, herb and box to its inside letters (ON, AG, ER, O) and 'done up' turns the run ONAGERO upwards. The whole clue describes a herb box with this herb packed inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Oregano is an aromatic Mediterranean herb, exactly what a herb box would hold.

clue.text: Keeping pressure on wildlife park about tax on introduction of impala

parts.note: P is the physics symbol for pressure

indicators.note: the reserve word goes around the tax and the impala's first letter

parts.note: a game reserve is a wildlife park
VAT is value added tax, the UK sales tax

indicators.note: the introduction of a word is its opening letter

explanation.surface: A game reserve imposes pressure and a tax on bringing in impala.
explanation.definitionFit: Preservative as an adjective describes what keeps or preserves something.

clue.text: Tear up without attention and run into the car in front

definitions.text: run into the car in front

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the tearing word goes around attention

parts.note: to rend is to tear apart
to give ear is to pay attention

explanation.surface: A careless driver rips up the road and crashes into the car ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: To rear-end is to drive into the back of the vehicle in front.

clue.text: Directions for drawing a capital A? Now there's novelty

definitions.text: Directions for drawing a capital A?

explanation.surface: Someone learns to draw a letter A and finds it a fresh experience.
explanation.walkthrough: The first reading spells the word as compass points N E W N E S S, a playful set of pen directions for tracing strokes; the question mark flags the whimsy.
explanation.definitionFit: Newness is the quality of being new, which is what novelty means.

clue.text: Tailored shirt she'd got, showing not much imagination

indicators.note: tailored means cut and reshaped, so these letters are refashioned

explanation.surface: A man in a tailored shirt is mocked for lacking imagination.
explanation.definitionFit: Short-sighted figuratively means lacking foresight or imagination about consequences.

clue.text: Longer-term laying up of leg cut by soldiers

indicators.note: a word cut by another is split open with the other inside

parts.note: a stage of a journey is a leg
OR is other ranks, ordinary soldiers

explanation.surface: Soldiers interrupt a stage of a long journey to lay up supplies.
explanation.definitionFit: Storage is keeping goods laid up for a longer period.

clue.text: Have trouble on hill with north wind

indicators.note: in an across clue on means placed after, so the trouble word follows hill and north

parts.note: a tor is a rocky hill, as on Dartmoor
ado means fuss or trouble

explanation.surface: Walkers have difficulty on a hill exposed to the north.
explanation.definitionFit: A tornado is a violent rotating wind storm.

clue.text: Poem of Robert Herrick, initially unknown to me

indicators.note: initially takes the first letters of the poet's two names

parts.note: Y is a mathematical unknown, like x

explanation.surface: Someone admits they had not heard of a poem by Robert Herrick.
explanation.definitionFit: A rhyme is a short verse or poem, as in nursery rhyme.

clue.text: Scornful outburst after many deliveries fail to stop where intended

indicators.note: after places the scornful outburst behind the deliveries

parts.note: in cricket an over is six balls, so overs are many deliveries
a hoot is a derisive shout

explanation.surface: A crowd jeers a bowler after a long spell of overs that miss their mark.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket an over is a set of six balls bowled, so overs are many deliveries.
explanation.definitionFit: To overshoot is to go past a target or stopping point by mistake.

clue.text: Current movement's sound rocks

parts.note: an eddy is a swirling movement of a current, with the possessive s kept
a tone is a sound

explanation.surface: The swirl of a current makes noise against rocks.
explanation.walkthrough: The Eddystone Rocks lie off Plymouth in Devon, site of a famous lighthouse.
explanation.definitionFit: The Eddystone is a reef of rocks in the English Channel near Plymouth.

clue.text: A suitable end for weapon plant

explanation.surface: Someone finds a fitting tip for a weapon among the plants.
explanation.walkthrough: An arrow's head is its pointed end; arrowhead is also a water plant with arrow-shaped leaves.
explanation.definitionFit: The point of an arrow is its head; arrowhead (Sagittaria) is also an aquatic plant.

clue.text: Dish — it's cooked with roots

indicators.note: cooked suggests the letters are worked over and rearranged

parts.note: it with the s read as is, a joining word

explanation.surface: A dish is said to be prepared with root vegetables.
explanation.definitionFit: Risotto is an Italian rice dish cooked slowly in stock.

clue.text: Kaiser's intention shortly to introduce pickelhaube, perhaps

indicators.note: shortly means the word is cut short, losing its last letter

parts.note: will means intention or purpose
a pickelhaube is a spiked German helmet, and helm is an old word for helmet

explanation.surface: The German emperor plans to bring in the spiked helmet.
explanation.walkthrough: Wilhelm II was the last German Kaiser, often pictured in a spiked pickelhaube.
explanation.definitionFit: Wilhelm was the name of the German emperors, Kaiser Wilhelm I and II.

clue.text: Italian island's Mafia leaders crushing resistance

indicators.note: crushing means squeezing something inside, so the bosses enclose resistance

parts.note: capi is the plural of capo, a Mafia boss
R is the physics symbol for resistance

explanation.surface: Mafia bosses on an Italian island stamp out opposition.
explanation.definitionFit: Capri is an island in the Bay of Naples, Italy.

clue.text: Tend to include starter on vegetarian lines where the main course is meat

definitions.text: where the main course is meat

indicators.note: the tending word takes in the vegetarian's first letter

parts.note: to care for is to tend

indicators.note: the starter of a word is its first letter

parts.note: RY is short for railway, a set of lines

explanation.surface: Someone caters for vegetarians at a restaurant famous for meat.
explanation.walkthrough: A carvery is a British restaurant or buffet serving roast meats carved to order.
explanation.definitionFit: A carvery is a restaurant where roast meat is carved and served as the main dish.

clue.text: Commercial traveller has cut down round to get ready

indicators.note: the cut-down word goes round the traveller

parts.note: to pare is to trim or cut down
a rep is a sales representative, a commercial traveller

explanation.surface: A salesman trims his rounds to be ready.
explanation.definitionFit: Prepare is a plain synonym for making things ready in advance, as in readying a meal.

clue.text: Hormone abuse occurring mostly at home

indicators.note: mostly means nearly all, so the abuse word loses its last letter

parts.note: an insult is verbal abuse
in means at home

explanation.surface: Hormone abuse is said to happen mostly in the home.
explanation.definitionFit: Insulin is the pancreatic hormone that controls blood sugar.

clue.text: Heartlessly nosy about time of birth

indicators.note: the trimmed nose word goes about the time letter
heartlessly removes the middle letter of the word

parts.note: nasal and nosy both mean to do with the nose

explanation.surface: A heartless busybody asks when someone was born.
explanation.walkthrough: Nosy here means of the nose; the obvious prying sense misleads.
explanation.definitionFit: Natal is an adjective meaning relating to birth.

clue.text: School's introduced American Indian cry

indicators.note: the school abbreviation has the people introduced into it

parts.note: SCH is the abbreviation for school
the Cree are a North American Indian people

explanation.surface: A school brings in a Native American war cry.
explanation.definitionFit: A screech is a shrill cry.

clue.text: Plead with first two of chorus that are out of step in ballet

indicators.note: out of means removed, so the chorus letters leave the step

parts.note: an entrechat is a ballet leap with crossing feet

indicators.note: the first two of a word are its opening pair of letters

explanation.surface: A dancer begs the leading chorus members who are out of step.
explanation.definitionFit: To entreat is to plead with or beg someone.

clue.text: Girl entering I rebuffed could be too old

indicators.note: the girl enters the turned self word
rebuffed means pushed back, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: the ego is the I, the self
Vera is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl joins in, but I turn her away for being too old.
explanation.definitionFit: Over age means beyond the permitted age limit, too old.

clue.text: Heed lady from reorganised 7

indicators.note: reorganised means the letters are arranged afresh

explanation.surface: A lady is told to take notice of a reorganised plan.
explanation.definitionFit: Formaldehyde, as formalin, is used to preserve specimens.
